findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "data.execute_batch" is 1343 chars, far longer than this server's median (175). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: [data] 【複数ツール連続の前に検討】tools:[{id,tool,args}] で MCP ツールを最大10件順次実行。{{stepId.field}} で前ステップ結果を参照。関連ツール3〜5本を個別呼び出しすると往復3〜5回＋ツール呼び出しオーバーヘッドが重複するが、execute_batch で1回にまと…

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "network.lookup_postal_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "security.validate_uuid" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: [security] UUID形式の検証とバージョン（v1-v5）・variant の判定 / Validate whether strings are properly formatted UUIDs and identify their version (v1-v5). Useful for checking us…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "security.generate_totp" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: [security] RFC 6238準拠のTOTPコード生成・検証（2FA向け・HMAC-SHA1。任意のtimestampで評価時刻を固定可。QR/otpauthはスコープ外） / Generates or validates RFC 6238 TOTP (time-based one-time password)…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: network.get_page_meta, convert.get_qrcode, network.http_fetch · Private data: utility.get_usage, utility.diagnose_mcp, datetime.generate_test_dates, text.estimate_tokens, text.split_text, security.generate_uuid, security.validate_uuid, security.generate_totp, network.dns_lookup · Public sink: network.lookup_postal_code, text.mask_pii, network.calc_cidr, network.http_fetch, data.validate_format · Destructive: data.execute_batch, datetime.get_cron_next, datetime.parse_laravel_schedule, convert.format, network.check_domain_format, network.http_fetch, data.validate_format, convert.format_number, datetime.format_relative_time, data.validate_schema, data.validate_all, convert.transform_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: network.get_page_meta, convert.get_qrcode, network.http_fetch · Private data: utility.get_usage, utility.diagnose_mcp, datetime.generate_test_dates, text.estimate_tokens, text.split_text, security.generate_uuid, security.validate_uuid, security.generate_totp, network.dns_lookup · Public sink: network.lookup_postal_code, text.mask_pii, network.calc_cidr, network.http_fetch, data.validate_format · Destructive: data.execute_batch, datetime.get_cron_next, datetime.parse_laravel_schedule, convert.format, network.check_domain_format, network.http_fetch, data.validate_format, convert.format_number, datetime.format_relative_time, data.validate_schema, data.validate_all, convert.transform_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
